verdict.rationale: Shopify's AI assistant, Sidekick, is documented on the POS features page as producing data-driven suggestions: reorder recommendations from sales velocity and seasonality, and stock-transfer recommendations from performance trends that it can create automatically. The evidence only covers inventory and stock suggestions. It does not show broader AI insights (sales, customers, staff), and it does not clarify whether Sidekick runs inside the POS app or only in the admin. missing for 10: broader AI insights beyond inventory, evidence that Sidekick is available in the POS app itself, in-depth docs, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product

citations.quote: Use Sidekick, Shopify’s AI assistant, to get reordering suggestions based on sales velocity and seasonality.
Ask Sidekick to recommend stock transfers between locations based on performance trends, and create them for you automatically.
